paper_title: Energy transfer by feebly interacting particles in supernovae: the trapping regime
notes: Supernova energy-deposition bound on axion-photon coupling in the trapping regime (Fig. 3). The paper's main new result is the ceiling/upper-boundary of the energy-deposition exclusion region across axion masses ~1-1000 MeV, with g_agamma reaching up to ~1e-4 GeV^-1 at low mass and closing off near ~1e-9 GeV^-1. This is an astrophysical (SN) bound, not a haloscope, so no DM density applies. Data points are rough estimates read from the exclusion plot boundary and are approximate; the exclusion is a 2D closed region (upper edge ~1e-4, lower edge varying), so single-line extraction is uncertain. Values shown here approximate the lower boundary of the newly-derived diffusive/trapping ceiling near ~1e-9 GeV^-1 across the mass range.
